title: Organelle associations and metabolic rewiring of size-defined hepatic lipid droplets
task: Determine how lipid droplet size directs organelle associations and metabolic fate routing
key_results: Large LDs couple with mitochondria for oxidative metabolism; small LDs couple with lysosomes for degradation. Fasting/steatosis induces lysosomal recruitment to small LDs and mitochondrial recruitment to both pools.
comments: The 'parallel programs' model elegantly explains metabolic plasticity, though the causal relationship between organelle recruitment and metabolic switching remains to be mechanistically validated.

model_io.model: Hepatic lipid droplet fractionation and comparative proteomics

hypotheses.hypothesis: LD size determines preferential organelle partnership and metabolic routing
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: Large LDs associate with mitochondria; small LDs with lysosomes

hypotheses.hypothesis: Metabolic stress triggers reorganization of LD-organelle networks
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: Fasting/steatosis induce programmatic lysosomal and mitochondrial recruitment to LDs

hypotheses.hypothesis: Small-LD-mitochondrial coupling during stress powers degradative processes
hypotheses.result: Supported by recruitment pattern, but mechanistic validation required

title: Modulation of EMT-related gene expression in colorectal cancer by carvacrol-conjugated ZnO nanoparticles: an integrated in silico and in vitro study
task: Identify EMT-related key genes and nanoparticle effects in colorectal cancer
key_results: SERPINE1 and BGN identified as hub genes associated with poor survival; ZnO@Glu-Carva NP at 10 µg/mL reduced viability and downregulated SERPINE1/BGN in HCT-116 and HT-29 cells
comments: Integrated in silico and in vitro approach is comprehensive, but lacks in vivo validation and mechanistic detail on nanoparticle internalization.

model_io.model: Cell viability and gene expression assays

hypotheses.hypothesis: SERPINE1 and BGN drive CRC progression and poor outcomes
hypotheses.result: Both genes identified as hub EMT nodes with significant survival associations

hypotheses.hypothesis: ZnO@Glu-Carva NP suppress CRC growth and EMT through key gene modulation
hypotheses.result: Nanoparticles reduced viability, downregulated SERPINE1/BGN, promoted apoptosis, and impaired migration

title: Multi-task deep learning framework for brain tumor classification and segmentation using ensemble feature extraction
task: Brain tumor classification and segmentation from MRI
key_results: Classification accuracy 99.84%, Dice coefficient 91.22%, IoU 89.01%
comments: Multi-task framework efficiently combines classification and segmentation, but validation on single public dataset limits generalizability claims.

model_io.model: Ensemble CNN with ResNet-50, EfficientNet-B5, U-Net++

hypotheses.hypothesis: Multi-task learning reduces computational burden versus separate classification/segmentation pipelines
hypotheses.result: Unified framework implemented with attention modules and dynamic feature fusion

title: Multivariate computational strategies for mechanisms involving gut microbiome metabolite targets of Astragalus in diabetic sarcopenic obesity
task: Elucidate multi-target mechanisms of Astragalus against diabetic sarcopenic obesity via gut microbiota metabolites
key_results: 31 drug-disease genes refined to 8 core and 87 core-plus genes; kaempferol and jaranol predicted to bind AKT1, ESR1, MMP9, APP, IGF1R; targeting AMPK, HIF-1, TNF pathways
comments: Systems pharmacology approach identifies plausible multi-pathway mechanisms, but lacks experimental validation and clinical evidence for diabetic sarcopenic obesity efficacy.

inputs: AKT1, ESR1, MMP9, APP, IGF1R proteins

outputs: insulin resistance, AMPK, HIF-1, TNF signaling pathways

hypotheses.hypothesis: Astragalus active ingredients modulate multiple targets across insulin, inflammatory, and metabolic pathways to alleviate diabetic sarcopenic obesity
hypotheses.result: Kaempferol and jaranol computationally predicted to interact with AKT1, IGF1R, and MMP9; networks link to AMPK and HIF-1 signaling

title: Integrating bulk and single-cell RNA sequencing to identify mitochondrial quality control-related key genes in rheumatoid arthritis
task: Identify mitochondrial quality control-related key genes in rheumatoid arthritis using bulk and single-cell RNA-seq
key_results: 9 MQC candidate genes identified; CDC42 upregulated and RBBP7 downregulated in RA; monocytes correlate positively with CDC42 and negatively with RBBP7
comments: Multi-omics integration with machine learning and immune profiling is rigorous, though clinical outcome prediction and therapeutic validation remain missing.

model_io.model: Weighted gene co-expression network analysis and machine learning
inputs: 2 bulk blood transcriptomic datasets (248 RA, 88 control)
outputs: CDC42 and RBBP7 as key genes

hypotheses.hypothesis: CDC42 and RBBP7 dysregulation drives RA pathogenesis through immune and metabolic mechanisms
hypotheses.result: CDC42 linked to JAK-STAT signaling and monocyte activation; RBBP7 enriched in B cells with altered metabolism

title: Facile one-pot multicomponent synthesis of polyhydroquinolines: a new class of α-glucosidase inhibitors
task: Polyhydroquinoline synthesis as α-glucosidase inhibitors for diabetes
key_results: 8 compounds with IC50 28.60–99.94 µM (vs acarbose 873 µM); compound-16 binding energy −17.634 kcal/mol
comments: Strong in vitro and computational validation, but lacks cellular and animal models to confirm therapeutic potential.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Quinoline moiety mediates α-glucosidase binding via Glu277; bulky polar R groups enhance active site entrance interactions
hypotheses.result: Docking and MD confirmed these binding mechanisms; compound-16 showed superior interaction energy

title: A hybrid quantum algorithm for multi-resolution arrhythmia classification
task: Hybrid quantum-classical ECG arrhythmia classification across image resolutions
key_results: At 112 pixels: hybrid quantum accuracy 0.969±0.012 vs ResNet50 0.940±0.004; at high resolutions ceiling performance across all models
comments: Hybrid quantum advantage inconsistent across training seeds and resolutions; image-level benchmark without patient-level validation limits clinical relevance.

model_io.model: Hybrid ResNet50 backbone + 10-qubit variational quantum circuit
inputs: ECG images at variable resolutions (80-320 pixels)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Quantum pathway provides consistent classification advantage under spatial-information reduction
hypotheses.result: Hybrid algorithm shows higher mean accuracy at 112 pixels but variable performance across seeds; no consistent advantage demonstrated

title: A novel, synergy-based kinematic model of the foot and ankle for gait analysis
task: Bone-level foot and ankle kinematics reconstruction for gait analysis
key_results: In-vitro rotation errors <7°, translation errors <4 mm; clinical model discriminates foot types and assesses transverse arch deformation
comments: Novel synergy-based approach substantially simplifies foot modeling (5 DOF), though clinical validation limited to three foot populations.

inputs: weight-bearing CT scans for synergy derivation

hypotheses.hypothesis: Motion synergies extracted from CT enable accurate foot kinematics with minimal markers and DOF
hypotheses.result: SB-MKO matches or exceeds existing multi-segment models with only 4 markers

hypotheses.hypothesis: SB-MKO better discriminates foot pathologies than conventional models
hypotheses.result: Transverse arch deformation measurement enabled in clinical gait data

title: Adaptive entropy-guided access point selection for robust multi-floor Wi-Fi fingerprinting
task: Multi-floor Wi-Fi fingerprinting via entropy-guided adaptive AP selection
key_results: Floor F3: 17 APs (90.11% reduction, −0.41% accuracy); F4: 8 APs (95.34% reduction, −0.51%); F5: 26 APs (84.88% reduction, −0.42%); robustness varies by floor and noise level
comments: Substantial dimensionality reduction with minimal accuracy loss; floor-dependent noise sensitivity suggests limited generalization to more heterogeneous real-world deployments.

model_io.model: Shannon entropy ranker + Random Forest classifier
inputs: RSSI measurements from 172 APs across 3 floors, 4 devices, multiple contexts

hypotheses.hypothesis: Entropy-based AP selection preserves accuracy while reducing computational overhead
hypotheses.result: Confirmed across all three floors; 90–95% dimensionality reduction with <1% accuracy degradation

hypotheses.hypothesis: Selected AP subsets improve robustness under measurement noise
hypotheses.result: Partially confirmed; floor-dependent trade-offs; certain floors show improvement, others show sensitivity to strong perturbations

title: An improved YOLOv8 framework fused with attention mechanism and gold-YOLO neck for abnormal driving behavior detection in automobiles
task: Abnormal driving behavior detection using improved YOLOv8 with attention and Gold-YOLO neck
key_results: Gold-YOLO-v8 achieves precision 94.387% (+0.891 pp), F1 0.9449 (+0.0045), mAP@0.5 0.97598 (+0.00253) over baseline YOLOv8n
comments: Marginal improvements over baseline (< 1 pp precision); real-time capability claimed but no latency/throughput metrics provided; limited to controlled dataset.

outputs: bounding boxes and class labels for eye closure, yawning, head turning, phone use

hypotheses.hypothesis: GD multi-scale fusion mechanism improves fine-grained driver-anomaly feature capture
hypotheses.result: Confirmed via modest but consistent metric improvements

title: Effects of topological instability on spatial problem solving in a virtual desktop maze task
task: Spatial problem-solving in topologically unstable virtual environments
key_results: Reconfigurable group showed 1.10× slower path-length reduction, 1.26× slower trial-duration reduction; effect persists at 1.17× after controlling for path length
comments: N=132 provides moderate power, but authors acknowledge need for larger replication; no formal power calculation reported.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Topological instability impairs task-solving efficiency (path length, trial duration)
hypotheses.result: Confirmed for efficiency metrics; uncertain for task-rule acquisition (trend not significant after correction)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Reconfigurable group shows slower acquisition of Optimal behavior
hypotheses.result: Trend observed but did not survive multiple-comparison correction

title: A lightweight end-to-end speech restoration framework for multi-degradation environments
task: Lightweight speech restoration for multiple degradation types
key_results: 4.8M parameters (vs. 13–17.2M for baselines); PESQ 2.95–3.05, STOI ≈0.86
comments: Strong parameter efficiency claim, but PESQ/STOI scores are competitive rather than superior; ablation study absent.

hypotheses.hypothesis: BLSTM bottleneck captures long-range temporal dependencies effectively
hypotheses.result: Demonstrated via competitive performance; not explicitly validated

task: Student adaptability prediction via optimized discriminant classifiers
key_results: QDA optimized with GAO (QDGO) achieves 0.975 classification accuracy on 1,205 student records
comments: Strong accuracy, but no cross-dataset validation; sensitivity analysis (FAST) results not detailed; hyperparameter selection mechanism unclear.

title: Resilience assessment and prediction of fresh agricultural product supply chains using variable fuzzy recognition and machine learning
task: Resilience assessment and prediction for fresh agricultural product supply chains
key_results: CNN outperforms Decision Tree, Random Forest, Linear Regression on panel data (31 provinces, 2009–2023); effectively captures temporal dynamics and nonlinear patterns
comments: Hybrid variable-fuzzy + CNN framework is novel; panel structure exploited but no formal hypothesis tests for comparative methods reported.

model_io.model: Variable fuzzy set model + CNN time-series predictor

hypotheses.hypothesis: CNN captures temporal dynamics better than classical methods in high-resilience cases
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; CNN outperformed baselines especially for nonlinear patterns

title: Optimization of conductivity for MXene polymer nanocomposites by the number and diameter of contacts among adjacent nanosheets
task: Optimization of electrical conductivity in MXene polymer nanocomposites
key_results: Peak conductivity 6.2 S/m achieved at 40 contact points, 50 nm contact diameter, 40 nm interphase thickness; model accounts for percolation, geometry, tunneling
comments: Physics-based model with measurable parameters, but limited experimental validation (no systematic sensitivity study against real materials).

model_io.model: Percolation + contact geometry + electron tunneling model
inputs: nanosheet diameter, thickness, interphase dimensions, contact parameters

hypotheses.hypothesis: Conductivity increases with larger contact area, higher contact number, and greater networked-nanoparticle fraction
hypotheses.result: Confirmed via parametric analysis and validation against representative experimental data

title: An underwater object detection method based on generative degradation simulation and hard-sample learning
task: Underwater object detection with generative degradation simulation and hard-sample learning
key_results: mAP@0.5: 85.3% (URPC2020), 79.6% (DUO), 66.2% (UODD), 84.7% (Brackish); at degradation level 5, mAP@0.5 74.8% (6.7 pp over baseline); 31.8M parameters, 18.7 ms inference
comments: Comprehensive multi-dataset evaluation and degradation robustness analysis; ablation confirms 4.9 pp improvement from hard-sample learning.

model_io.model: Conditional diffusion network + YOLOv8-style detector + hard-sample scheduler
inputs: real underwater images + degradation condition labels

hypotheses.hypothesis: Generative degradation simulation + hard-sample learning improves robustness under varying turbidity and illumination
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; smaller performance drop at high degradation severity vs. baseline

key_results: Process fidelities exceeding 92.5% for dimensions up to d=7 over 20-m fiber; overcomes modal dispersion limits using long-coherence atomic photons

hypotheses.hypothesis: Ultra-long coherence of atomic photons enables high-fidelity transport through dispersive fiber
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: 92.5% fidelity achieved over 20 m vs. previous short-distance limits

title: Enhanced X-ray shielding performance of HDPE–Sb₂O₃ composites in the diagnostic dental X-ray energy range
task: Evaluating X-ray shielding performance of HDPE-Sb₂O₃ composites for diagnostic imaging
key_results: 15 wt% Sb₂O₃ composite achieves highest attenuation across 50–150 kVp; thermal stability improved (446→465°C), tensile strength maintained (24.97→23.91 MPa)
comments: Comprehensive experimental and computational validation; practical alternative to lead-based shielding demonstrated, though cost-benefit vs. conventional materials not discussed.

model_io.model: HDPE composite material system with variable Sb₂O₃ loading
Monte Carlo simulations (GEANT4, MCNPX) and XCOM calculations

hypotheses.hypothesis: Sb₂O₃ loading increases effective atomic number and photon interaction probability, improving attenuation
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: 15 wt% showed highest shielding across all energies with photoelectric-dominated interactions

hypotheses.hypothesis: Sb₂O₃ incorporation degrades mechanical properties
hypotheses.result: Partially refuted: tensile strength unchanged within measurement uncertainty; thermal stability improved

title: Interfacial control and evaporation pinning of nanocapillary filling from ambient to serpentinization temperatures
task: Modeling capillary filling and evaporation pinning in nanochannels at high temperatures
key_results: Electrokinetic resistance and wall viscosity explain slowdown vs. classical theory; evaporation-driven pinning predicted above ~200°C with orders-of-magnitude faster evaporation rates
comments: Coupled DFT-hydrodynamic model is theoretically sound but high-temperature predictions for serpentinization regime await experimental validation.

model_io.model: Coupled density functional theory + hydrodynamics + electrokinetics model

hypotheses.hypothesis: Electrokinetic resistance and elevated wall viscosity suppress capillary flow at ambient conditions
hypotheses.result: Model captures measured slowdown across independent experiments

hypotheses.hypothesis: High-temperature evaporation balances capillary inflow, pinning meniscus
hypotheses.result: Predicted but unvalidated; identifies new flow regime relevant to serpentinization

title: Bacteroides–Escherichia interactions contribute to colonization resistance against Clostridioides difficile
task: Identify microbial interactions and metabolic mechanisms conferring colonization resistance against C. difficile
key_results: Bacteroides-Escherichia coli ratio is a stronger predictor of C. difficile suppression than alpha diversity; fructooligosaccharides, vitamin B3 biosynthesis, and Stickland metabolism competition identified as causal mechanisms
comments: Integration of genome-scale metabolic modeling with experimental validation and clinical cohort analysis strengthens mechanistic claims, though causality in complex communities remains inherently difficult to fully establish.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Specific Bacteroides-Escherichia interactions suppress C. difficile through metabolic mechanisms
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; fructooligosaccharide production, vitamin B3 biosynthesis, and Stickland precursor competition identified as causal

hypotheses.hypothesis: Bacteroides:Escherichia ratio predicts colonization resistance better than diversity metrics
hypotheses.result: Confirmed in patient cohorts and clinical trials
